listings.Job Description: We are in search of a French-speaking, proactive, and driven HR Intern to join our Human Resources team. This position will assist in auditing the company’s HR policies, procedures and personnel documents to ensure compliance. This role will provide a hands-on experience in understanding HR processes, policy development and document management, while contributing to the company’s efforts in maintaining accurate, up-to-date, and compliant HR practices.
listings.Job Requirements: Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with attention to detail. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with HR software is a plus. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with professionalism. A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and adaptability to a fast-paced work environment. Fluency in English and French are required.
